consensus_points.headline: The dispatcher defaults to External runtime mode; the workflow does not pass --runtime-mode; and tests lock the empty-panel behavior as APPROVE with subagent_runtime_pending=true plus a pr-review-approved event. That is a fail-open review signal unless every…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Change missing/incomplete panels to CHANGES_REQUESTED or REJECT at the dispatcher boundary, and make the workflow pass an explicit runtime mode only when a complete panel is produced.

consensus_points.headline: The PR adds M01/M02 gate evidence but the main worktree state shows many later untracked/dirty gate changes; completion claims need branch-local reproducibility rather than ambient workspace state.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Tie each gate evidence file to a commit SHA and command output so reruns prove the exact branch, not a dirty workstation.

consensus_points.headline: The gate still carries transitional role mappings for `application` and `runtime` even after the repo moved toward `usecase`/`app` layer names. That is necessary for transition but weakens clean-architecture enforcement if it is not time-boxed.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Add an explicit sunset/ratchet fixture that fails once the three named follow-ups land and removes the legacy role aliases.

consensus_points.headline: New active lane `oya-governance-merge-queue-ref-hygiene` runs `oya-vcs-merge-queue-fix-loop-app -- --gc-staging-refs --max-age-seconds 3600`, but the app parser in this PR only accepts `--workspace-root`, `--initial-head-sha`, `--now-epoch`, and…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Implement the GC flags in the app and add a CLI regression test, or mark the lane planned/inactive until the command exists.

consensus_points.headline: The new usecase crate duplicates the 21-facet panel while the dispatcher keeps its own `FacetId::full_panel_v23`. The comment says it mirrors the dispatcher list, which is exactly the double-bookkeeping the boundary fix should delete.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Move the authoritative facet enum/list into the usecase crate and have the dispatcher import it. Keep one source of truth; delete the mirror test and duplicate enum.

consensus_points.headline: PR #8 touched/validated gates while the sanctioned-primitives runbook still instructed grit/icm flows. ADR-0116 later retired them, but this PR still demonstrates doc/gate drift during the transition.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Ensure retired-vocabulary gates cover runbooks and migrate preflight references to Foundry pipeline/plain git surfaces.

consensus_shifts_from_round_1_to_round_2: Final synthesis incorporates facet-specific reviewer evidence after the initial merged-PR inventory pass.
Round 2 rebuttal evidence is now recorded for every F1-F9 facet before declaring consensus.

executor_topology_compliance.rule: Each F1-F9 facet has a distinct reviewer_id for primary evidence, and each round-2 rebuttal has a distinct round-specific reviewer_id; no reviewer_id is reused across facets within the change_id.

naming_justification: evidence/debate/pr-8-synthesis.json is the canonical synthesis path for PR #8 under the multispectrum debate evidence naming contract.
pr_title: Keep M01/M02 local gates honest with usecase boundary

round_2_evidence_policy.consensus_declaration_precondition: Every synthesis facet_evidence_paths list includes each primary facet review and the matching rebuttal-round evidence before termination_reason=consensus_reached.

unresolved_tensions: Retrospective review landed after PR #8 was already merged; blockers are represented as FixupTasks rather than pre-merge holds.
